Patch Set 1:

(2 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, comments inline. The check itself looks correct on both sides and I could not find a legitimate caller that is now broken. One coverage gap worth noting: because llapi_layout_file_comp_set() rejects the request before fsetxattr() is ever called, sanity-ec.sh test_6f exercises only the library check -- the whole test still passes with just the liblustreapi_layout.c hunk applied, and nothing reaches the new lod_declare_layout_set() check. If that server-side check is meant to guard against an unpatched or hand-rolled client, is there a way to cover it (a raw fsetxattr of XATTR_LUSTRE_LOV".set.flags", or an llapi_layout_test.c case in the style of T67)?

commit.subject: LU-19994 ec: block LCME_FL_PARITY flag changes
commit.message:
LU-19994 ec: block LCME_FL_PARITY flag changes

The LCME_FL_PARITY flag is reserved for EC parity mirrors that are
created implicitly by the --ec option.  It must not be settable on a
file layout component through "lfs setstripe --comp-set
--comp-flags=parity", nor clearable with "^parity", on either a
plain data component or the data component of an EC file.
